# cambrian — Origin

## Source

- **Copied from**: [cambrian-mllm/cambrian](https://github.com/cambrian-mllm/cambrian) (Apache-2.0),
  the `cambrian/` package (vendored here as `cambrian_pkg/`)

## Local modifications

Heavily adapted (~900 lines differ in `cambrian_arch.py`): trimmed to the
inference paths needed by the MapSpatial backend, removed training code.

## Included third-party components

This subtree retains files with their original copyright headers, including
Haotian Liu / LLaVA-derived code (Apache-2.0) and Meta SAM (Apache-2.0).
